name: Docker Operations
description: Inspect containers, images, networks, and logs, then confirm container health after any change.

permissionsRequired.reason: Run docker ps, inspect, and logs on the local engine.
Run the same docker checks on a configured server alias.
Read a local Dockerfile or compose file before changing it.

validation.rule: Container state or logs were read before any change, and container health was checked again after a mutating docker command.
